summary.text: NORGESHUS AS is a private limited company registered in Melhus, founded 1988-06-03. NORGESHUS AS driver med arkitekt- og byggteknisk virksomhet, herunder ingeniør- og arkitektvirksomhet, eie og utvikling av franchisekonseptet Norgeshus, samt investering i og eie av selskaper i annen tilknyttet virksomhet. It was previously named IDECON AS until 2009-04-30. Its main industry code is 71.121: civil engineering activities. The register shows 59 employees and 6 registered workplaces. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 148 246 303 NOK and the annual result was 8 956 218 NOK; operating income was up from 145 529 493 NOK in 2024. The annual result rose from 3 985 525 NOK in 2024 to 8 956 218 NOK in 2025. Equity rose from 36 610 003 NOK in 2024 to 38 064 967 NOK in 2025. Registered leadership: Benn Asgeir Båtvik (daglig leder) and Dag Runar Båtvik (styrets leder), with 6 other board members. Its verified website is meieridammen.no. The registered employee count went from 62 on 2025-11-13 to 59 on 2026-09-15. The register's most recent update was on 2026-09-15 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
